I work competently in 9 others\"","dimension":"Go centrality","description":"This captures whether Go is presented as one language among several or as the applicant’s main language for the role.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"Python is my second working language\" vs. \"I am an experienced Python developer\"","dimension":"Python emphasis","description":"This captures how strongly the letter highlights Python as a core skill relevant to the backend and AI-agent aspects of the job.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"capture-the-flag competitions\" and \"built a fault-tolerant message broker from scratch\" vs. \"OSCP certification\" and \"open-source project\"","dimension":"hands-on security credentials","description":"This captures the depth of explicit security and technical credibility signals beyond work history, such as certifications, competitions, or side projects.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"\"practicing the offense\" and \"build systems whose success is measured in incidents that never occur\" vs. \"strengthening security across the entire development lifecycle\"","dimension":"security philosophy","description":"This captures the extent to which the writer articulates a nuanced personal philosophy about how security work should be done.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"\"from day one\" vs. \"at your convenience\"","dimension":"direct contribution assertiveness","description":"This captures how forcefully the letter projects immediate readiness and eagerness to contribute versus a more formal, reserved close.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"\"I am motivated by teams...\" and \"I join capture-the-flag competitions regularly\" vs. \"I am confident the team's standards and my own working habits are well matched\"","dimension":"personal enthusiasm","description":"This captures the amount of personal energy and intrinsic motivation conveyed through the letter’s tone and examples.","winner":"A"}]}
